name: app-bad-vs-good-checkout-ui-comparison-split
title: Bad versus Good Checkout UI Comparison
whatItIs: A split image comparing a cluttered checkout with a red cross and a red Place Order button against a clean checkout with a green tick, numbered sections, icons on fields, payment method tiles and a green Pay Securely button.
whatItMeans: Side-by-side before and after with red and green makes the lesson obvious, and grouping and icons show what better looks like.
techniques: Before and after split with red and green headers

vocabulary.definition: Two versions of a design shown side by side.
